title: N1E38 proof checker assumed wrong receipt shape
objective: Prove existing N1E36 regression result and then inspect PREBUILD binding without rerunning tests.
summary: N1E38 reached the persisted N1E36 executor state but its local proof script exited before PREBUILD binding checks because it required a top-level exit_code representation. The wake detail shows the N1E36 state exists, has the expected branch and completed timestamps; this N1E38 failure does not prove the underlying regression failed.
why: The verification script encoded a receipt-shape assumption instead of reading the executor's actual per-operation result fields.
next_action: Read only the compact persisted N1E36 status, exact operation argv/rc/result output and classify PASS/FAIL from the actual receipt schema. Do not rerun unittest. If regression PASS is proven, continue directly to PREBUILD binding inspection.
first_incomplete_step: Classify N1E36 from its actual persisted executor receipt fields.
